legal.title: Legal & compliance
legal.subtitle: Platform templates filled with your details. You are the controller; the platform is the processor.
legal.incompleteBanner: Legal name or privacy email is missing. Complete them for coherent policies (does not block bulletin publishing).
legal.noPermission: settings.manage permission is required to manage Legal.
legal.documentsHint: Template mode (recommended), external URL, or edited (publish body from a future version).
legal.retentionPlaceholder: E.g. bulletin versions ≥ 365 days; short sessions; logs 12–24 months.

customer_portal.title: Customer portal
customer_portal.description: Enable or disable sharing bulletins and reports with customers via secure links.
customer_portal.readOnly: You need the settings.manage permission to configure the customer portal.
customer_portal.loadError: Failed to load customer portal status
customer_portal.platformDisabled: The customer portal is disabled at platform level. Contact support; the local toggle will have no effect until it is restored.
customer_portal.toggleHint: When disabled, new share links cannot be created.
customer_portal.readyHint: The portal is active and shares can be created from project bulletins.
customer_portal.toggleError: Could not update the customer portal

access.title: Named portal access
access.description: Invite a person with a verified email linked to a company. The link is single-use and the secret is shown only once.
access.notAllowed: The plan or platform does not allow granting named customer portal access. Upgrade the plan or contact support.
access.noRelationships: No active relationships. Add one on the contact record.
access.noChannels: A verified email on the person record is required.
access.freshSecret: New secret (copy now — it will not be shown again)
access.inviteCreated: Invite created and copied. The secret cannot be recovered later.
access.noCopyExisting: Existing invites have no Copy button: the secret is not recoverable.
access.errRelationship: An active company–person relationship is required.
access.errChannel: A verified, active email channel is required.
access.errPrincipal: The principal type or contact is not valid for this invite.
access.errNotAllowed: The plan or platform does not allow granting named access.
access.errLimit: The plan portal user limit has been reached.
access.errRelationshipActive: There is already an active relationship between this company and person.
access.errPermission: Customer portal access management permission is required.
access.manageAtContacts: Manage invites and grants from Contacts → Customer portal, or the Portal tab on each account.

customer_portal.contentDefaultsHint: Defaults for new bulletins. Each bulletin can override them.
customer_portal.bccHint: Comma-separated addresses copied on bulletin emails (tenant-level).
customer_portal.bccSoon: Advanced configuration coming soon. Meanwhile, manage recipients and rules from Contacts.
customer_portal.localesHint: Languages available in the customer portal. The default is used when the account has no preferred locale.
customer_portal.allowClientLocale: Clients can change the portal language
customer_portal.allowClientLocaleHint: When enabled, the change is saved to the account preferred_locale.
customer_portal.profileHint: Shown on the customer portal. Empty fields inherit the tenant name and the first active site.
